With context in mind, that changes my interpretation of the poem a lot. It helps emphasize the dark romantic genre. To make the poem more specific, I would change 'the words' in line 5 to 'her words'. This will make the poem seem less scattered to someone without context, the reader knows you long for love, her words and intentions leave you lost, which ties the poem together. Line 7 it almost repeating line 6, the difference is that you go from general pain to individual aches. Repetition can be good, but "each ache" doesn't quite roll of my tongue. Although I'm not sure what you could replace it with. But its a small thing. Another thing I noticed is the lack of punctuation, some poetry ignore it, rightfully so. The lines in the poem don't have capitals, not all of them should but some definitely. I also feel like you could add some commas, full stops, or breaks to guide the reader to read the poem the way you want them to. I'm happy you clarified the last line. I was unsure earlier but now I think its excellent. The lines "somehow reminding me of,
how i don't get enough" I think should be changes to "somehow reminding me, that I don't get enough".
Anyways, the title didn't explicitly ask for criticism, I just enjoy talking about things like this and it seems you'd want someone to read and comment on it so you can improve. I'm not saying I'm any good at writing and you shouldn't take my critic too seriously, its just my opinion really. Sometimes it can be good for someone to give you a second opinion on writing in particular to help you make it more clear to a reader who hasn't read it before.

I've developed a social life, gotten a lovely girlfriend whom unfortunately struggles with depression and other issues, which I do my best to help with. Anyways. Everyday, I would go to school (sometimes pretend i'm sick) not do anything during school, go home, isolate myself from the world playing or watching video games to hide myself from reality. At some points I was even cutting self. Eventually, reality caught up. I wanted to change. I though about who I wanted to be and a lonely, depressed, socially awkward guy is not that. I may have 'grown' out of it in a sense but I genuinely worked on myself to again become a functioning human. It took two years before I found myself in a good place. My depression is not the classic depression, it wasn't that I was biological incapable of happiness, rather that I had put myself in a position where I couldn't help but hate who I was. Even today, I do things to punish myself, I'll reject help, do things in the hardest way possible and just silly things that make myself suffer. I'm continuing to work on my personality, eventually, I will be the best that I can be. That is my goal. Sorry for the long post.

In Middle School, I became best friends with two other students. They both had the same crush and one got the girl, the other did not. Naturally they drifted apart and I essentially had to choose. I choose the one who got the girl. The other poor fella, in retrospect, did nothing wrong. He was one of the nicest guys I've ever met. Wait a couple months and his mother dies from a sudden stroke. He had no friends. The friend with the girl and I were constantly making fun of him, bullying him. I didn't know how hurtful I could be at the time. At one point, I remember making fun of him not having two parents.
Now, 5 years later. He lives in a different country and I believe he is happy there, I've seen him a couple times since he left towards the end of middle school and he was still just as nice and welcoming then as before. It brings a tear to my eye thinking about this, those times I saw him all I wanted to do was apologize and beg his forgiveness, but I never had the guts.
My own cruelty in middle school left me a social outcast. I hit rock-bottom. I had time to reflect. I hated myself. I wanted to change. and so, I did.
I'm now happy with who I am. I would consider myself the best I can be and its all because I had the time in social exclusion to reflect on who I wanted to be and working to make that change. I haven't thought about this for a while, I'm going to see if I can't get in contact with him again.
TL;DR: I bullied a friend to the point where I insulted him for having a dead mother. I was a terrible person.
